name: Chained Cravings
source:
A galloze struggles in vain against his restraints. He looks up at you, his captor. In your hand lies the power to decide your tied fates. But be careful, for his kind is known for being slippery.

[From [url=https://sidesteph.itch.io/chained-cravings]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一只绞车徒劳地反抗他的束缚。他抬头看着你，他的俘虏。你的手中掌握着决定你们命运的力量。但要小心，因为他的同类以狡猾着称。

[来自[url=https://sidesteph.itch.io/chained-cravings]itch.io[/url]]
